title: Robot Basketball Slam Dunk
summary: An action-packed sports video prompt featuring a robot player performing a series of dribbles and a powerful dunk.
prompt: A basketball game. [Image 1] receives a pass from a teammate. Starts dribbling from the center circle. Bypassing one defender, then another, and finishing with a slam dunk. Multi-shot. Diverse camera work. Shot sizes and camera angles. Effective lighting. Team name is Dogs, opposing team is Cats. Dazzling stadium lights. The stands are full. Effective impact frames. A sense of urgency and tension.
